description: Make parseAmount() in src/amount.js accept text with spaces around the number, so that parseAmount('  42 ') returns 42.
check: git rev-parse -q --verify main >/dev/null && for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only main -- test/); do test -f "$f" || exit 1; if git diff main -- "$f" | grep -v '^--- ' | grep -q '^-'; then exit 1; fi; done && npm test
